subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `announceTarget: "parent"` as a native, model-facing `sessions_spawn` completion-routing contract with fail-closed external delivery suppression?
rationale: The implementation appears intentionally bounded and proof-backed, but deciding whether this new orchestration control belongs in the stable native tool contract is product and compatibility policy rather than a mechanical correctness choice.

options.title: Accept the opt-in native contract
options.body: Keep the per-spawn-only option, preserve omission behavior, and land only after the exact-head CI gate completes.

options.title: Decline this routing mode
options.body: Keep current completion behavior and close the feature direction without adding a parallel orchestration contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in native contract
recommendation.body: Keep the per-spawn-only option, preserve omission behavior, and land only after the exact-head CI gate completes.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected area needs an identified agents-subsystem owner to make the public-contract decision; reliable ownership attribution was unavailable from the supplied context.
